objective: Stress-test the already frozen HAR-RSV proxy specification on a newly discovered, later-period public Japan 225 1-minute sample without changing the true-OSE promotion requirement.

source.instrument: Japan 225 index/CFD-style proxy, not OSE futures
source.license: Repository declares MIT for the sample repository; raw sample remains upstream and is not copied into this repo.

frozen_transformation.sampling: 5-minute last price within AM and PM separately

models.challenger: HAR_RSV: logRV_t ~ 1 + lagRSV+ + lagRSV- + lag5mean + lag22mean

CURRENT_SAMPLE_PROXY_CONSISTENT: HAR_RSV beats HAR_RV on both OOS QLIKE and MSE
block-bootstrap probability of positive improvement >= 0.95 on at least one of QLIKE or MSE

formal_true_jnu_rule: Even a positive G2 result remains proxy evidence only. HAR-RSV still requires the frozen true-OSE mini Stage A and JNU micro Stage B before any validated JNU promotion.
forbidden: Change session windows after outcome inspection
Add leverage/jump/neural features to rescue a negative G2 result
Call proxy consistency a true-JNU PASS
Use this family as directional alpha
